Browse material topic collections, or list assets inside a specific topic.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h, --help                            Print this help message and exit
      --type TEXT REQUIRED              Required. Material asset type key, such as `music`, `sticker`,
                                        `effect`, `transition`, `text_template`, `sound`, `photo`, or
                                        `video`.
      --resource-platform <vimo|heycan|loki|1|2> 
                                        Material library source for visual/audio topics. Use `vimo`,
                                        `heycan`, or `loki`; ignored for `--type music`.
      --scene TEXT                      Music topic/list scene hint. Topic/recommended music use numeric
                                        scenes; similar music defaults to `edit` when omitted.
      --id INT                          Topic ID returned by `material topic`. When set, list concrete
                                        assets inside this topic pool.
      --topic-key TEXT                  Topic key returned by `material topic`. Optional when the topic
                                        ID is sufficient.
      --list-source <topic|recommended|template-fit|similar> 
                                        Music list source (`--type music` only). Use `topic` with `--id`,
                                        or `recommended`, `template-fit`, or `similar`.
      --limit INT:POSITIVE [10]         Maximum number of items to return in list mode. Default is 10.
      --cursor INT:NONNEGATIVE [0]      Paging cursor for list mode, starts from 0.
      --template-id <template-id>       Music list template-fit only: template ID.
      --seed-resource-id <seed-resource-id> 
                                        Music list similar only: seed resource ID.
      --seed-clip-id <seed-clip-id>     Music list similar only: seed clip ID.
      --request-id <request-id>         Music list only: request ID for correlation or paging.
      --filter-commercial               Music list only: restrict songs to commercially usable music.
      --intelligence-reorder            Visual/audio list only: enable intelligence reorder.
      --channel <online|test|local_test> 
                                        Material request channel. Use `test` or `local_test` for internal
                                        test resources.
  -v, --version                         Show version information and exit.
      --jq TEXT                         Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                                        .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                                        the full schema envelope.

WHEN TO USE
  - Without `--id`: list curated topic pools for the given asset type
    (hot / holiday / style / scene / playlist / collection).
  - With `--id <topic_id>`: list concrete assets inside that topic pool.
  - For music, `--id` may be omitted when combined with a `--list-source`
    other than `topic` (e.g. `recommended`, `template-fit`, `similar`).

EXAMPLES
  # List topics under an asset type
  $ lyra-cli material topic --type sticker
  $ lyra-cli material topic --type music

  # List assets inside a topic
  $ lyra-cli material topic --type sticker --id 123 --limit 10
  $ lyra-cli material topic --type music   --list-source recommended --limit 10
  $ lyra-cli material topic --type music   --list-source similar --seed-resource-id 6944678306690085633

OUTPUT
  Without `--id`: result.topics[] with topic_id / topic_key / topic_name / topic_source.
  With `--id` (or music `--list-source`): result.items[].resource_id for query, download, or draft handoff.
